title: The Cost of Context
body: Dumb AI and smart AI use the same model. The difference is context.

For a long time I wondered why my AI outputs felt generic. Then I realized I was giving it generic inputs. Not because I meant to. Because I hadn't built the structure to give it the right context automatically.

Now I have a memory system. Files that tell the AI who I am, what I'm working on, what good looks like for me, what I care about and what I don't. Every prompt loads the right context without me having to re-explain myself.
The difference between an AI that feels like a tool and one that feels like a collaborator is almost always this. Not the model. The context.
